name: B. Ranganathan
quote: Excellent initiative. Requires lot of sacrifice determination and dedication. Covering 3 various activities namely providing necessary provisions and groceries for Veda padasala, providing clothing to old age homes and food for children with disabilities. May your services grow multifold in the years to come.

name: L. Sundaresan
quote: The Trust is doing a meaningful service by extending education support to underprivileged students through food, clothing, and other essential assistance. This holistic support helps students focus on their education without being held back by basic financial difficulties. The initiative provides encouragement, dignity, and confidence to students from disadvantaged backgrounds. We sincerely appreciate the Trust’s continued efforts to support education and create better opportunities for deserving students.

name: Rajesh Narayanan
quote: The Pichumani Sri Lakshmi Narasimhan Trust is very unique in the sense it is not run by wealthy people. But by individuals who are from middle class background. The trust identifies the right cause and mobilises from closely known donors to deliver to needy in a consistent manner. Mr Narasimhan who started this trust has done this beyond his means but trusting the donor society to help the needy. It is a great honour and blessing to be part of this movement. I encourage all who can contribute as minimum as Rs.1,000/- per year to reach out to Mr Narasimhan and start your donor journey.

name: Sathiya Bama
quote: The Trust provides valuable support to underprivileged students through food, clothing, and other essential needs. These efforts help students continue their education with greater confidence and dignity. A truly commendable initiative for supporting education and empowering deserving children.

name: R. Saravanan
quote: The Trust is doing a commendable service by providing food support to destitute elders in orphan homes and underprivileged children studying at Veda Patashala. These efforts help meet their basic nutritional needs and bring comfort and happiness to their lives. A truly thoughtful initiative towards caring for the elderly and supporting children in need.

name: R. GajendraVelu
quote: Service to the Needy Mankind is Service to the God and in this way this Trust is doing a wonderful service by distributing clothes to destitute and needy persons with care and compassion. This initiative helps meet an essential need and brings dignity, comfort, and happiness to those facing difficult circumstances. Such thoughtful support makes a meaningful difference in the lives of underprivileged people. We sincerely appreciate the Trust’s continued efforts towards serving the needy and contributing to the welfare of society. This Trust acts as a role model for the younger Generations by creating an awareness to do such great activity to the Human Society. Our Hearty wishes for all the members of the Team, to keep continuing this good work for ever, in the years to come.

name: R. Rajeesh
quote:
The Trust is doing a deeply commendable service by providing consistent, nutritious food support to destitute elderly individuals and children living in welfare homes. This critical initiative ensures that these vulnerable groups receive the regular, balanced meals they need alongside the care and dignity they truly deserve.

By addressing hunger, such compassionate efforts bring immediate happiness and comfort while directly supporting their fundamental survival needs. We extend our combined, sincere appreciation to the Trust for its invaluable contribution toward the long-term welfare, health, and overall well-being of both destitute elders and underprivileged children in our communities.

name: Jayagopal Suresh
quote: The Trust is doing a commendable service by providing financial assistance to students from economically weaker families for their educational needs. This support helps deserving students continue their studies without the burden of financial difficulties. The initiative provides encouragement and hope to students to pursue their academic goals and build a better future. We sincerely appreciate the Trust’s valuable contribution towards supporting education and empowering young students.

name: Senthamil Selvi V
quote: It is heartwarming to see the Trust providing food support to destitute elders in orphan homes and underprivileged children studying at Veda Patashala. Their caring efforts bring not only nutritious meals but also a sense of love, dignity, and happiness to those in need. We truly appreciate the Trust for touching lives through such thoughtful and compassionate service.

name: G. Saranya
quote: The Trust is doing a commendable service by providing nutritious food support to destitude elders and children living in homes. This initiative helps ensure that the destitude elders & children receive regular meals and the care they deserve. Such compassionate efforts bring happiness and comfort while supporting their basic needs. We sincerely appreciate the Trust for its valuable contribution towards the welfare and well-being of destitude elders & underprivileged children.

name: K. Selvi
quote: The Trust is doing a wonderful service by distributing clothes to destitute and needy persons with care and compassion. This initiative helps meet an essential need and brings dignity, comfort, and happiness to those facing difficult circumstances. Such thoughtful support makes a meaningful difference in the lives of underprivileged people. We sincerely appreciate the Trust’s continued efforts towards serving the needy and contributing to the welfare of society.
